Ledger confirms hardware implant attack, says systems not breached

Ledger said an unauthorized hardware implant was found inside an affected device, confirming physical tampering. The company said there is no evidence its own infrastructure, systems or services were compromised, while distributor CryptoBilis has suspended hardware wallet sales. Ledger advised affected users to avoid initializing unused devices and consider moving assets to wallets created with new recovery phrases. Earlier on-chain analysis estimated losses linked to the incident at more than $86 million. — link
